text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a research article focused on species distribution modeling of camel ticks (Hyalomma dromedarii) in Saudi Arabia and UAE using MaxEnt modeling. Although land use/land cover (LULC) is included as one of the environmental variables influencing tick habitat suitability, the primary objective is the prediction of tick species distribution, not LULC prediction or simulation. The study does not implement multiple future LULC scenarios or produce mapped LULC projections. The future projections modeled are climate scenarios (ssp2-4.5) affecting tick distribution, not LULC change scenarios. Therefore, it does not meet the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction focused research.)
